slovak: Keby ona bola prišla o hodinu skôr, tú aukciu by bola vyhrala.
answer: Had she arrived an hour earlier, she would have won the auction.

slovak: Keby on bol pribalil náhradnú dušu, tú prasknutú pneumatiku by bol vymenil hneď.
answer: If he packed a spare inner tube, he would change the burst tire right away.

slovak: Dedko nám ten starý budík bude opravovať celý týždeň.
answer: Grandpa will be repairing the old watch for us all week.

slovak: Na drevenom móle sú tri prevrátené člny.
answer: Three capsized boats are on the wooden pier.

slovak: Do soboty ona zdigitalizuje všetky tie rodinné negatívy.
answer: By Saturday she'll have digitized all of the family negatives.

slovak: Dnes ráno poriadne mrzlo a kamenné schody boli šmykľavé.
answer: This morning it was freezing hard, and the stone steps were very slippery.

slovak: Moja teta pletie deťom hrubé vlnené ponožky každú zimu.
answer: My aunt knits thick woolen scarves for the kids every winter.

slovak: Ona práve ukladá tie sklenené poháre do drevenej debny.
answer: She is just putting the glasses into a wooden crate.

slovak: Zvyčajne ona píše tie poznámky rukou, ale dnes ich diktuje do telefónu.
answer: She usually writes the notes by hand, but today she's dictating them into her tablet.

slovak: V tejto obci budú staré stodoly prestavané na remeselné dielne.
answer: In this village, they converted the old barns into craft workshops.

slovak: Náš ujo strúha deťom drevené píšťalky každé leto.
answer: Every summer our uncle whittles wooden whistles for the children.

slovak: Knihovník mi povedal, že on dnes prelistoval už tri hrubé katalógy.
answer: The librarian told me that he had already leafed through three thick books today.

slovak: Do konca mesiaca oni skatalogizujú celý farský archív.
answer: They will have catalogued the whole parish archive by the end of the month.

slovak: Oni nám oznámili, že oni ten výťah opravili ešte v stredu.
answer: They inform us that they had already fixed the elevator on Wednesday.

slovak: My triedime papier a sklo do dvoch veľkých košov.
answer: We sort paper and plastic into two large bins.

slovak: On nalieva do tej panvice ešte trochu olivového oleja.
answer: He is pouring a little more olive oil into the pan on the stove.

slovak: Keď zazvonil zvonec, Emma ešte ukladala tie nástroje do skrinky.
answer: When the bell rang, Emma were still putting the tools away in the cabinet.

slovak: Vy nám do nedele pošlete tie podpísané formuláre.
answer: You will send us the signed contracts by Sunday.

slovak: Zuzana bude tie medené kľučky leštiť celé popoludnie.
answer: Zuzana is going to be polishing the copper handles all afternoon.

slovak: Vy každý štvrtok znášate tie ťažké debny do pivnice.
answer: You carry the heavy crates down to the cellar every Thursday.
